# GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP) GUI Interface

## System and Window Information

- **Operating System Environment**: Linux (based on desktop environment indicators)
- **Window Title**: GNU Image Manipulation Program
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in top-right corner
- **System Tray**: Located in top-right corner with icons for notifications, sound, and system status
- **Desktop Environment**: Activities panel visible on left side, indicating GNOME or similar desktop environment
- **Date and Time**: Displayed in top-center of the screen as "Oct 22 20:40"

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Bar**: Located at the top of the application window
- **Menu Items** (from left to right):
  - File
  - Edit
  - Select
  - View
  - Image
  - Layer
  - Colors
  - Tools
  - Filters
  - Windows
  - Help

## File Menu Dropdown

- **File Menu is Open**: The "File" menu is expanded, showing its options
- **File Menu Options**:
  - New... (Ctrl+N)
  - Create (with submenu indicator >)
  - Open... (Ctrl+O)
  - Open as Layers... (Ctrl+Alt+O)
  - Open Location...
  - Open Recent (with submenu indicator >)
  - Save... (Ctrl+S)
  - Save As... (Shift+Ctrl+S)
  - Save a Copy...
  - Revert
  - Export... (Ctrl+E)
  - Export As... (Shift+Ctrl+E)
  - Create Template...
  - Print... (Ctrl+P)
  - Send by Email...
  - Copy Image Location
  - Show in File Manager (Ctrl+Alt+F)
  - Close View (Ctrl+W)
  - Close All (Shift+Ctrl+W)
  - Quit (Ctrl+Q)

## Left Sidebar (Desktop Environment Panel)

- **Application Dock**: Vertical panel on the left side of the screen
- **Application Icons** (top to bottom):
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird Email Client
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP (currently active)
  - File Manager
  - Software Center (AppGrid)
  - Help (Question Mark)
  - Trash Can
- **Application Grid Icon**: Located at the bottom of the dock for accessing all applications

## Main Application Workspace

- **Canvas Area**: Large central area with a dark gray background
- **Canvas Content**: Partially visible abstract graphic with curved shapes and circular elements
- **Canvas Status**: No active image is fully loaded or visible; the canvas appears to be blank or contains a placeholder

## Right Sidebar (Tool Panels)

### Tool Options Panel

- **Tool Selection Area**: Located at the top of the right sidebar
- **Tool Icons**:
  - Selection Tool (black square with white border)
  - Paintbrush Tool (yellow brush icon)
  - Text Tool (letter "A" icon)
  - Eraser Tool (pink eraser icon)
- **Filter Selection**: "filter" label with dropdown arrow
- **Current Filter**: "2. Hardness 050 (51 x 51)" selected
- **Brush Presets**: Grid of brush shapes including stars, circles, and textured brushes
- **Brush Settings**:
  - "Basic," dropdown menu
  - "Spacing" input field with value "10.0" and up/down arrows

### Layer Panel

- **Layer Management**:
  - Three horizontal lines icon (layer group)
  - Two vertical lines icon (layer visibility)
  - X icon (layer deletion)
- **Layer Properties**:
  - "Mode" dropdown with "Normal" selected
  - "Opacity" field with value "100.0"
  - "Lock" section with icons for locking transparency, position, and pixels

### Additional Settings Panel

- **Highlight Settings**:
  - "Highlight" toggle (currently off)
  - "Highlight opacity" field with value "50.0"
- **Guides Settings**:
  - "No guides" dropdown
- **Canvas Behavior**:
  - "Auto Shrink" button
  - "Shrink merged" checkbox (unchecked)

## Bottom Toolbar (Canvas Controls)

- **Canvas Navigation Tools**:
  - Zoom In (magnifying glass with plus sign)
  - Zoom Out (magnifying glass with minus sign)
  - Reset Zoom (circular arrow)
  - Rotate Canvas (circular arrow with rotation indicator)
- **Canvas Positioning**:
  - Move Canvas (arrow icon)
  - Pan Canvas (hand icon)
  - Zoom Canvas (magnifying glass icon)

## Status Bar (Bottom of Application Window)
